title: Offer diligence workflow
subtitle: Use existing tabs to document contract risk before you score Risk Safety.

steps.title: Answer Contract risk diligence
steps.detail: Open Questions and complete the Contract risk (or Group/contract risk) group for every lead. Cover non-compete radius/duration/scope, malpractice type, tail payer, termination without cause, and repayment clawbacks.

steps.title: Quantify terms in Volume
steps.detail: Enter numbers in the contract rows at the bottom of Volume: non-compete miles, duration in months, and tail estimate. Example: "25 mi / 18 mo" and "Physician-paid tail ~$45k claims-made".

steps.title: Compare to benchmarks
steps.detail: Enter licensed MGMA/AMGA/internal data in Benchmarks, or use community reference ranges as a sanity check — then compare each lead's recurring comp and productivity unit to median.

steps.title: Log deal-breakers in Pros/Cons
steps.detail: Put non-negotiable contract issues in Cons and Follow-up questions on each lead. These surface in Compare, Report, and the negotiation letter.

steps.title: Score Risk Safety last
steps.detail: Only set Risk Safety (riskFit) after contract diligence is documented. Use 4–6 when terms need attorney review; 7+ only when non-compete, tail, termination, and clawbacks are acceptable for your market.

universalContractNorms.source: Physician Side Gigs community database (2023–2025); illustrative only
universalContractNorms.tailNote: Claims-made departure tail often $10k–$100k+ depending on specialty and state; confirm who pays on voluntary vs involuntary exit.
